title: 第216章 另外的战场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

雁门关打得热闹，帝都安阳城也没闲着，甚至比雁门关还要热闹。

安阳城原守军两万余人，在巡防营将军常胜率领下与铁先生的十万北燕军周旋，别看兵力悬殊，北燕军想一口吃下这两万人还真不是什么容易事儿。

虞明基高座王城心急如焚，但他却不怕，誓要与安阳共存亡，保留住荣耀之国的帝王该有的尊严。

临战前，天子专门传下旨意，从国库中拨出三百万两白银以示犒军，此三百万两白银全部发派给两万将士的家属，并言明，胜者各个加官晋爵，死者其家属由国库出资赡养天伦。

由此看来，天子下定决心誓守安阳城，将士们身无顾忌，各个勇猛，以肉体之躯硬是堵住北燕军前进的脚步，当然代价是惨痛的。

打到最后，常胜的守军只剩下不足千人，反观北燕军依旧生龙活虎，这次安阳城应该攻陷了吧。

铁先生是这么想的，数日激战北燕军已经占据了大半个安阳城，城中百姓不知去向，那些留守的大臣们派人将其家属全部接进皇宫，街上再无往日欢腾，一片萧条景象。

至于承国第一亲王安隆王虞成国，这几天是他长这么大以来最难过的几天，一方面自己的皇位继承权岌岌可危，另一方面天子已经知道他与铁先生有来往，无论安阳保下保不下，这个事都不好处理，不算雁门关的黑甲军，光是安阳这边已经死了两万多将士，最后这笔账都得算在他头上。

完了……完了……经营数十年到头来功亏一篑。

最为讽刺的是，他的安隆王府如今成了北燕军的帅营，名义上与他无关，但私底下人们都在议论，这是安隆王府在攻打天子禁宫。

现在说什么都晚了，只希望父皇能够宽大处理，最起码保留住他这个爵位。

臣子们没了往日神气，一个个像霜打的茄子都蔫了，坐卧不宁，就好像世界末日一般。

只有虞明基心里清楚，京城尚有十万镇西军，只是他现在还不想用，关键时刻给予敌军致命一击。

同时虞明基心里清楚，战争一旦开始就没那么容易结束，北燕和南凉敢坐在脖颈子上拉屎，那就要付出代价。

反观铁先生，他的十万大军如今剩下不足十万人，并未选择贸然进攻，而是围而不攻，依旧打算不耗费兵力拿下安阳城。

因此，战斗陷入僵持阶段，一直到第十日终于出现转机。

这个转机源自一封军报，当然是雁门关传回来的军报，上面写明雁门关大捷，已将联军赶回去，并歼敌十余万，虞明基等的就是这个。

按理说前方传来捷报应该是大喜之事，可众位大臣们面目迟疑，根本没有什么欢喜模样，眼神里充满绝望。

虞明基默不作声，将军报小心的揣入怀中，站起身。

“来人，传巡防营将军常胜！”

天子一语打破沉寂，抬起头，不知道这时候传常胜还有什么意义。

没多久，常胜身着残破战甲上殿觐见，虽然只剩下不足千人兵力，但在常胜眼中看不到一丝畏惧。

“常胜，朕问你，目前安阳还有多少兵力！”

“回陛下，已……已不足千人！”

“朕要的是具体数字！”

“还……还剩八百二十三人，这其中还有不少受伤者！”

虞明基点点头：“传令下去，对北燕军发起进攻！”

一听这话大臣们傻了眼，心想皇上该不是疯了吧，八百多人主动进攻十万大军，这跟找死有什么区别。

常胜原地没动，他倒不是害怕，只是八百人就算打出花来也打不过十万人啊！

Page (1/3)

Yanmen Pass was bustling with excitement, and Anyang City, the imperial capital, was not idle either. It was even more lively than Yanmen Pass.

The original garrison of Anyang City consisted of more than 20,000 people. Under the leadership of General Chang Sheng of the patrol battalion, they dealt with Mr. Tie's 100,000 Northern Yan Army. Regardless of the disparity in strength, it was not easy for the Northern Yan Army to devour 20,000 people in one go.

Yu Mingji was anxious in his high seat in the royal city, but he was not afraid. He vowed to live and die with Anyang and retain the dignity that an emperor of the Kingdom of Glory should have.

Before the war, the emperor specially issued a decree to allocate three million taels of silver from the national treasury to reward the army. All three million taels of silver were distributed to the families of 20,000 soldiers. He also stated that the victors would be promoted to high positions, and the families of the deceased would be supported by the national treasury to support their families.

From this point of view, the emperor made up his mind to defend Anyang City. The soldiers had no scruples and were brave and blocked the advance of the Northern Yan army with their physical bodies. Of course, the price was heavy.

At the end of the battle, the ever-victorious defenders had less than a thousand men left. On the other hand, the Beiyan army was still vigorous and vigorous. Anyang City should have been captured this time.

Mr. Tie thought so. After several days of fierce fighting, the Northern Yan army had occupied most of Anyang City. The people in the city were nowhere to be found. The ministers who stayed behind sent people to bring all their families into the palace. The streets were no longer as joyful as before, and there was a depressed scene.

As for the first prince of Chengguo, Anlong Wang Yu Chengguo, these few days have been the saddest days for him since he grew up. On the one hand, his succession to the throne is in jeopardy, and on the other hand, the emperor already knows that he has dealings with Mr. Tie. Regardless of whether Anyang can protect him or not, this matter is not easy to deal with. Not counting the black armored army at Yanmen Pass, more than 20,000 soldiers have died in Anyang alone. In the end, this debt will have to be settled on him.

It’s over… it’s over… After decades of business, it’s all gone.

The most ironic thing is that his Anlong Palace has now become the headquarters of the Northern Yan Army. It has nothing to do with him in name, but privately people are talking that this is Anlong Palace attacking the Emperor's Forbidden Palace.

It's too late to say anything now. I just hope that my father can be lenient and at least keep his title.

The ministers lost their former dignity, all wilted like eggplants beaten by frost, and restless, as if the world was ending.

Only Yu Mingji knew in his heart that there were still 100,000 troops to suppress the West in the capital, but he didn't want to use them yet, so he could give the enemy a fatal blow at the critical moment.

At the same time, Yu Mingji knew in his heart that once the war started, it would not be easy to end. Beiyan and Nanliang would have to pay the price if they dared to sit on their necks and shit.

On the other hand, Mr. Tie, with less than 100,000 people left in his 100,000-strong army, did not choose to attack rashly, but instead besieged instead of attacking, and still planned to capture Anyang City without spending any troops.

Therefore, the battle fell into a stalemate until the tenth day when it finally turned around.

This turning point came from a military report, which was of course sent back from Yanmen Pass. It stated that the victory at Yanmen Pass had driven the coalition forces back and wiped out more than 100,000 enemies. This was what Yu Mingji was waiting for.

It stands to reason that the good news coming from the front should be a great joy, but the faces of the ministers were hesitant, showing no signs of joy at all, and their eyes were full of despair.

Yu Mingji remained silent, carefully put the general's newspaper into his arms and stood up.

"Come here, it's said that the general of the patrol camp always wins!"

The emperor broke the silence with a word and raised his head. He didn't know what the meaning of Changsheng was at this time.

Not long after, Chang Sheng came up to the palace wearing a broken battle armor. Although there were only less than a thousand soldiers left, there was no trace of fear in Chang Sheng's eyes.

"Chang Sheng, I ask you, how many troops are there in Anyang now?"

"Your Majesty, there are already... less than a thousand people!"

"I want specific numbers!"

"There are...eight hundred and twenty-three people left, and there are still many injured among them!"

Yu Mingji nodded: "Send the order and launch an attack on the Beiyan Army!"

Upon hearing this, the ministers were dumbfounded and thought that the emperor must be crazy. More than 800 people took the initiative to attack an army of 100,000 people. What is the difference between this and seeking death.

Chang Sheng didn't move where he was. It wasn't that he was afraid, it was just that even if 800 people played tricks, they still couldn't defeat 100,000 people!
